items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...choose two people that you’ve played with... So I chose Barbra Streisand and Rancid. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Wow. ... Check that out. No kidding. That’s crazy.

ctx.x: And I remember going in, and the producer was Babyface. And I went to overdub. They already had – JR had played drums, Paul Jackson Jr., Eric was going to come in and play the guitar. And here’s an example of a great producer. Babyface would come in, says, “Hey check it out. Listen to the song.” He goes, “You know what to do.” So I went in there and did my thing. But the song was so great, I came home and I went like, “I think I just played on a hit song.” Eric Clapton. Okay. And another time it was, this is a…

You know I went down your list, a little mind exercise, I said I’m going to see if – choose two people that you’ve played with, or bands, that seem the farthest extreme possible. So I chose Barbra Streisand and Rancid.
